subject: Re: Procurement & Pricing - Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <s.lee@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement & Pricing - Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for taking the demo with us today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

1) Recap of the ask:
- ACME is evaluating Redwood to power search-summarization and customer support routing for two business units.
- Primary procurement questions: PO vs card, vendor onboarding timeline, SOW requirements, and marketplace listing for ease of procurement.
- Technical preference: start on hosted (fastest time-to-value) but procurement may request Dedicated or Private for data isolation and SLA.

2) Pricing/packaging to consider before procurement: 
- Hosted (on-demand): pay-as-you-go, no commit, fastest onboarding — good for pilot and early usage.
- Dedicated (committed capacity): monthly/annual reserved GPUs, predictable throughput and pricing, SLA-backed — preferred for production traffic at scale.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): enterprise license + support, longer procurement and onboarding timeline.

3) Commercial questions we need from ACME to prepare final paperwork:
- Preferred payment method (PO vs corporate card).
- Internal review/approval steps and target signature date.
- If PO: billing contact and any required vendor paperwork (W9, vendor form).
- Interest in using cloud marketplace (AWS Marketplace) vs direct contract.

Attachments: Redwood_PRICING_2027_Q1.pdf (pricing grid + commit options), SOW_draft_v2.docx (template SOW).

Proposed next steps: 
- If PO: I can send a billing-ready quote and SOW for your procurement team to review.
- If card/on-demand: we can get you live on hosted within 48 hours.
- Marissa will scope packaging/pricing based on your projected usage; Dev will follow up with technical checklist for Dedicated/Private.

Can you confirm which path you prefer (PO vs card) and whether ACME would prefer a marketplace listing? Also please share your procurement contact or vendor form if PO is the route.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if it's easier.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Thanks, Aditya — great demo and clear next steps. A few notes from procurement here: 

- ACME prefers to purchase via PO for enterprise vendors. We will need a signed SOW and a billing quote that maps to line items for invoicing.
- Typical vendor onboarding takes ~3 weeks once we have the SOW and required vendor paperwork. Attached is the vendor info form we use — can you fill and return? (ACME_vendor_info_form.pdf)
- Marketplace: we prefer direct contracts for solutions that require SLAs; marketplace procurement is possible but would require additional vendor enablement on our side. If Redwood is already on AWS Marketplace, that would help speed certain BU purchases.

A couple of technical clarifications for your engineering team (cc’ing procurement):
- For Dedicated: does Redwood require a minimum commit (e.g., 3+ GPUs) or are there small-reserved options?
- For Private: timeline and minimum professional services estimate?

Happy to coordinate the procurement folks to review the SOW once you’ve updated it for PO billing.

Samantha Lee
Director, Platform Product
ACME Corp
s.lee@acme-corp.com

Thanks Samantha — that's very helpful. Quick responses inline and next steps: 

- We’ll complete the vendor form and return today (attaching ACME_vendor_info_form_filled).
- Dedicated commits: we have flexible tiers. Minimum practical commit is typically a 3-GPU pool for predictable throughput, but we can propose a smaller starter reserved capacity + autoscale burst to on-demand if that fits your procurement rules. I’ll ask Marissa to draft two pricing options (3-GPU commit vs blended starter + burst) and mark which requires a PO.
- Private/on-prem: typical timeline is 6–8 weeks from signed contract for a standard VPC deployment; PS estimate varies by integration scope — Dev, can you add a ballpark for PS hours and a short checklist of what we’ll need from ACME?

Marissa — can you prepare the billing-ready quote and SOW updated for PO billing (line items + billing contacts)? Aim to have a first draft by Tue EOD.
Dev — please prepare a brief technical checklist (networking, VPN, audit logs, KMS) and PS estimate for Private.

I’ll also include a HubSpot link and a DocuSign-ready SOW once Marissa posts the quote (linking to the deal below). Proposed timeline:
- Mon: Redwood returns vendor form and draft quote/SOW
